verdict.rationale: Xero shows built-in automations (JAX auto-reconciliation matching, duplicate bill detection, automated bill data extraction) and exposes APIs/webhooks plus an MCP server that could be used by developers to build custom event-triggered actions, but there is no evidence of a native user-facing rules/trigger builder where an AI-native user defines arbitrary 'if event then action' rules. Missing for 10: a documented rules engine or webhook/trigger configuration UI, evidence of custom trigger-action mapping, and independent confirmation that such automation works end-to-end.
